stories.title: Estée Lauder director sells $10.05 million in stock
stories.summary: Estée Lauder director Fribourg sold $10.05 million of class A common stock. Investing.com reported the sale from a regulatory filing. The filing did not give a reason for the sale.
stories.whyItMatters: Large insider sales draw attention as a sentiment signal. One sale alone does not confirm a trend.
whatToWatch: Future filings on insider buying or selling

stories.title: Yen holds steady against euro and dollar after weak Japan GDP
stories.summary: The yen traded steady against the euro and dollar. This followed a weaker-than-expected Japanese GDP report. Investing.com said the muted reaction suggests markets had priced in the weak data.
stories.whyItMatters: Japan's growth data shapes Bank of Japan rate expectations. Those expectations move yen-funded trades worldwide.
whatToWatch: The Bank of Japan's next policy signal
Yen moves against the dollar and euro in coming sessions
questions: Why did the yen stay steady despite weak growth?
Will the data change the BOJ's rate path?

sources.title: Yen steady against euro and dollar after soft Japanese GDP data

stories.title: US flight delays and cancellations stretch into a third day
stories.summary: Thousands of US flights were canceled or delayed for a third straight day. Investing.com reported the disruption. The report did not name a cause, carrier, or airport.
stories.whyItMatters: Long disruptions raise airline costs and hurt revenue. They can also dent travel-sector sentiment before the holiday season.
whatToWatch: Whether delays ease or extend to a fourth day
Airline comments on the cost of the disruption
questions: What is causing the multi-day disruption?
Which airlines and airports face the worst delays?
